title: SSC Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Examination 2026 – Apply Online for 2536 Posts
vacancyDetails: 2,536 vacancies for posts to be notified under the SSC CHSL 2026 recruitment process.
qualification: 12th Pass or equivalent from a recognized board or university.
ageLimit: 18 to 27 years as on 01 Jan 2026 (age relaxation as per SSC rules).
applicationFee: ₹100 for General/OBC/EWS male candidates. Women, SC, ST, PwBD and eligible reserve categories may be exempted as per SSC rules.
selectionProcess: Tier-I Computer Based Examination, Tier-II Computer Based Examination, and Skill Test / Typing Test where applicable.
documentsRequired: Aadhaar or valid photo ID, 12th class certificate, recent photograph, signature, category certificate (if applicable), and other supporting documents as notified.
howToApply:
1. Visit the official SSC portal at https://ssc.gov.in
2. Complete the One-Time Registration (OTR) if not already done
3. Open the CHSL 2026 application under Live Examinations
4. Fill the online form, upload documents and photo/signature
5. Pay the application fee if applicable and submit the form
6. Download the submitted application and keep the acknowledgment for future reference
shortDescription: SSC CHSL 2026 recruitment for 2,536 posts. Apply online for 10+2 level vacancies with official SSC dates, eligibility, fee and application steps.
content:
Staff Selection Commission (SSC) has invited applications for the Combined Higher Secondary (10+2) Examination 2026.

The recruitment is for 2,536 posts across the posts and departments notified in the official advertisement. Eligible candidates who have passed Class 12 can apply through the official SSC portal.

Eligibility and selection

The basic educational qualification is 12th Pass or equivalent. The age limit is generally 18 to 27 years as on the notified reference date, with category-wise relaxation as per SSC rules. The selection process includes Tier-I, Tier-II, and the relevant skill or typing test as required for the post.

Application fee

The application fee is ₹100 for eligible general category male applicants. Women and reserved category candidates may be exempted as per the official notification. Candidates should check the detailed notice before final submission.
